components.name: ProUpgradePrompt
components.summary: Consistent upgrade state for Pro-only workspace capabilities.
components.notes: The prompt is explanatory only; every paid operation is independently enforced on the server.

components.name: BillingAccessBanner
components.summary: Persistent verified-checkout and payment-grace status shown across the authenticated workspace.
components.notes: Renders directly from the reactive Convex subscription record and never grants optimistic access.

components.name: DocsActions
components.summary: Client-only controls for copying and downloading the exact Markdown source behind a public documentation page.
components.notes: Keeps browser clipboard and Blob APIs outside the server-rendered documentation shell.

components.name: DocsSearch
components.summary: Searchable documentation navigation shared by desktop and mobile docs layouts.
components.notes: Filters the static documentation manifest without fetching or duplicating server data.

components.name: MarkdownDocument
components.summary: Server-rendered Markdown document with GFM tables, anchored headings, internal links, and dual-theme Shiki code blocks.
components.notes: Keeps documentation rendering server-first; only clipboard, download, and navigation filtering require client components.

components.name: DatabaseAccessPicker
components.summary: Searchable multi-select database access picker shared by Content API integration creation and access editing.
components.notes: Selection is UI draft state; the available database list remains a live Convex query.

components.name: AuthForm
components.summary: Better Auth email/password form shared by sign-in and sign-up routes.
components.notes: Redirects successful authentication to the documents workspace.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: Theme-aware Nexfiy brand mark shared by landing and authentication surfaces.
components.notes: Uses the existing light and dark brand assets.

components.name: NexfiyProCheckout
components.summary: Authenticated Dodo checkout and customer-portal control for the single Nexfiy Pro per-seat plan.
components.notes: Seat quantity is sent to Dodo checkout; active subscription state comes from verified Convex webhook data.

components.name: OrganizationProvider
components.summary: Provides the active Better Auth organization and organization switching throughout the authenticated workspace.
components.notes: Organization context is for workspace UX; Convex functions remain responsible for server-side authorization.

components.name: WorkspaceAvatar
components.summary: Rounded workspace identity mark that displays an available image or a name-derived initial.
components.notes: Uses the account avatar for personal workspaces and the Better Auth organization logo when present.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Accessible Radix-based custom select menu used instead of native browser dropdowns.
components.notes: Includes trigger, content, item, label, separator, and scroll controls.

components.name: LegalPage
components.summary: Theme-aware marketing document layout shared by Nexfiy legal pages.
components.notes: Server-rendered shell with shared navigation, footer, document typography, and contact panel.

components.name: TemplateGalleryDialog
components.summary: Realtime gallery for instantiating saved nested page templates at the workspace root or beneath a current page.
components.notes: Template data remains in Convex; successful instantiation navigates to the newly created root page.

components.name: NormalizedBlockNoteEditor
components.summary: BlockNote editor and read-only renderer backed by normalized page blocks.
components.notes: Keeps the default BlockNote editing experience while persisting blocks through the normalized Convex page-block model.
